newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia noon rubber weaker on poor demand.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia noon rubber weaker on poor demand.

text.p: Rubber prices in Malaysia were weaker, extending the downtrend due to a lack of consumers demand and losses in Tokyo, dealers said.

"Sentiment continues bearish. Prices are seen falling day by day and buyers are keeping away from the market," a dealer at a trading firm said. "Consumers are not interested at these current levels. Buyers want to wait and get cheaper prices."
The summer holidays and poor far-east demand also weakened prices, they said.
"We don't expect much happening today due to end-month factors and the start of the month," a trader said.
Dealers offered SMR CV at 312 cents, SMR L at 292 cents, SMR 20 at 243 and latex at 212 cents.
July RSS Ones buyer fell three cents to 260.50 cents ($1.03) a kg and July SMR 20 buyer was down half a cent at 245.

A Malaysia-based shipping agent quoted freight rates for rubber from Malaysia to Rotterdam at $800 per TEU (or 20-ft container), and $1,700 per two-TEU containers (or 40-ft container). --Tan Lee Lee -603 275-6834 ($1-2.5240)
